text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking down the hall, I hear
Grass
Wonder's voice coming from the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the medicine. I will take
my leave
now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. Just a little headache, it's
no big—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Dear me. It seems this medicine
might take
a while to kick in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seems to be having
trouble with
headaches. It may be a
good idea to take it easy
on her for a
little while.
